instructions:
Write an essay in response to the assignment below, the way a US grade 8 student would write it in class for a timed writing test. Aim for about 350 words. The file must contain only the essay itself: no notes, no commentary, no word count.

Assignment: When people ask for advice, they sometimes talk to more than one person. Explain why seeking multiple opinions can help someone make a better choice. Use specific details and examples in your response.
